d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains a major political showdown brewing in Washington over how the Trump administration is securing critical minerals across Africa—and whether it used lifesaving US foreign aid as leverage. According to a Semafor report, Democratic lawmakers plan to use their incoming congressional majorities in January 2027 to launch formal investigations into 'secretive' mineral agreements with resource-rich nations like Zambia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
